## Findings checked and refused (no change)

- Scripture identifications and numbering in the notes (Isa 60:1, Zech 9:9, Ps 8:2 / Matt 21:16, Isa 54:13, Ps 81:3, Isa 40:10 / 62:11, Ps 118:26, Gen 49, Ps 29:6, 22:21, 92:10, 45:8, Hab 3:4, Asc. Isa 3 and 9–11): all kept; the notes already mark Ezra and the loose Solomon citation as unmatched.
- ወልዲ ያዕቆብ as "son of Jacob": not kept as the main reading (see 16) but retained in the note as possible.
- ሠረቀ with accusative ወስብሐተ (unit 1): left; the glossary entry for ወስብሐተ calls it accusative, which matches Bezold's habit.
- ፍሡሓት "feminine plural": left; the -ት plural is formally feminine and the note is not wrong.
- ወየኀፅብ "he washes" / ልብሶ: parses and renderings confirmed.
- Unit boundaries, `p` flags and the stray-wordspace notes (ን ፡ ጉሥኪ, ነገሥ ፡ ት): confirmed against the packet.
- ሶንዶኖ as σινδών, አስካል "cluster", በረድ "hail": left, already marked (?).
